title: Abnormal cases on the network side

entities.name: Authentication and key agreement procedure for 5G ProSe UE-to-network relay
entities.description: Procedure for authenticating and establishing keys for 5G ProSe UE-to-network relay functionality.

entities.name: UE-initiated de-registration procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by the UE to de-register from the network.

entities.name: RELAY KEY AUTHENTICATION RESPONSE message
entities.description: Message sent during the authentication and key agreement procedure for 5G ProSe UE-to-network relay.

entities.name: Lower layer failure before RELAY KEY AUTHENTICATION RESPONSE message is received
entities.description: Abnormal condition where lower layer failure occurs before receiving the RELAY KEY AUTHENTICATION RESPONSE message.

entities.name: Collision between authentication and key agreement procedure and de-registration procedure
entities.description: Condition where authentication and key agreement procedure for 5G ProSe UE-to-network relay collides with UE-initiated de-registration procedure.

entities.name: Collision between authentication and key agreement procedure and other 5GMM procedures
entities.description: Condition where authentication and key agreement procedure for 5G ProSe UE-to-network relay collides with other 5GMM procedures except de-registration.

entities.name: Network aborts authentication and key agreement procedure
entities.description: Network behavior to abort the authentication and key agreement procedure for 5G ProSe UE-to-network relay.

entities.name: Network proceeds with UE-initiated de-registration procedure
entities.description: Network behavior to proceed with the UE-initiated de-registration procedure.

entities.name: Network progresses both procedures
entities.description: Network behavior to progress both the authentication and key agreement procedure and other 5GMM procedures.

relations.description: Lower layer failure condition causes the network to abort the authentication and key agreement procedure.
Collision with de-registration procedure causes the network to abort the authentication and key agreement procedure.
Collision with de-registration procedure causes the network to proceed with the UE-initiated de-registration procedure.
Collision with other 5GMM procedures causes the network to progress both procedures.
Lower layer failure condition is defined relative to the RELAY KEY AUTHENTICATION RESPONSE message not being received.
